{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "indexes",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies TxIndex in src/index/txindex.cpp to raise runtime exceptions on disk read failures and index corruption rather than returning null.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "TxIndex currently masks disk I/O failures and index corruption by returning null pointers, treating unreadable data as missing transactions. As noted in commit 3333a91dbf, 'a -txindex corruption may also point to a larger system corruption and it seems better to notify the user properly', aligning directly with the index priority that silent false negatives and integrity masking are worse than explicit failures."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Has the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies src/rpc/rawtransaction.cpp error handling for getrawtransaction and ProcessPSBT.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "RPC methods currently return misleading 'No such transaction found' errors during I/O errors or when blocks are pruned or un-downloaded. The PR description notes that 'Reporting a confirmed transaction as missing is wrong, so properly return an error instead', fixing returned error correctness for RPC consumers."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",

      "rationale": "A test that pins the behavior of a specific functional area belongs to that area, not to test infrastructure."

categories.name: indexes
categories.evidence: Modifies TxIndex in src/index/txindex.cpp to raise runtime exceptions on disk read failures and index corruption rather than returning null.

As noted in commit 3333a91dbf, 'a -txindex corruption may also point to a larger system corruption and it seems better to notify the user properly', aligning directly with the index priority that silent false negatives and integrity masking are worse than explicit failures.

categories.rationale: RPC methods currently return misleading 'No such transaction found' errors during I/O errors or when blocks are pruned or un-downloaded.
